title: AI-Powered Personal Knowledge Hub
summary: A personal knowledge management system that enables users to store notes, attach files, and perform semantic AI-powered search across their data. The system integrates a custom ingestion pipeline that parses notes, extracts content from files, generates embeddings, and enables Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) for contextual answers. It supports both traditional text search and AI search with references, along with cached note summarization for efficiency.
desc: Built a scalable ingestion pipeline to parse note content, extract text from files (PDF, images, DOCX, etc.), and generate embeddings.
Implemented semantic search using vector similarity over stored embeddings for accurate context retrieval.
Designed a RAG-based AI search system that returns grounded answers with source references.
Added summary generation with caching to reduce repeated LLM calls and optimize token usage.
Separated architecture into API (orchestration), Search (AI processing), and Storage layers for modularity.

title: Offline-First Farm Harvest & Pack Management System

caseStudy.title: Overview
caseStudy.content: A production-grade Progressive Web App designed for field operations in environments with unreliable or no internet connectivity.

caseStudy.title: Problem
caseStudy.content: Field users frequently operate without stable connectivity, leading to failed API calls, partial submissions, and inconsistent system state in traditional online-only architectures.

caseStudy.title: Solution
caseStudy.content: Designed an offline-first architecture using IndexedDB for durable client-side storage and an outbox pattern to queue write operations. Connectivity listeners trigger background sync, while idempotent backend APIs safely replay queued requests.

caseStudy.title: Key Engineering Highlights
content: Centralized sync state using store patterns

caseStudy.title: Results & Impact
content: Improved perceived performance for field users
Significant reduction in sync-related support issues
Successfully used in daily production workflows

title: CareConnect - Hospital Management System
desc: Engineered a low-latency chat module using SignalR, supporting 1:1 and group messaging.
Implemented granular RBAC (Role-Based Access Control) for Admins, Physicians, and Patients using JWT.
Designed a normalized PostgreSQL schema optimized for complex medical history queries.
Built end-to-end document handling for secure prescription uploads.
summary: A real-time, secure hospital ecosystem built for scale.
challenge: Most hospital systems are fragmented, forcing users to switch between tools. The goal was to engineer a unified ecosystem that seamlessly handles three distinct, conflicting workflows (Admin oversight, Physician diagnostics, and Patient booking) within a single secure interface using JWT authentication.
